name: La Porte Secure Spots
summary: Secure trailer parking and drop yard spots in La Porte, leased by the day, the week or month to month.

hero.eyebrow: Secure trailer parking in La Porte
hero.title: Secure trailer parking
hero.lead: A lighted, fenced yard with security cameras, unique coded entry and 24/7 controlled access. Contact us today to reserve your spot.

groups.title: Trailer Parking
groups.summary: Spots for loaded and empty trailers, leased per spot by the day or the month.
groups.intro: Spots are leased one spot at a time, for a day or for the long run. The daily rate is $50 per spot and the monthly rate is $295 per spot, with long term options available.
groups.imageAlt: Dry van trailers parked side by side at a loading dock

services.title: Trailer Spots
services.text: Park a loaded or empty trailer on a spot of its own and pull it when it is needed.
points: One spot, or up to 31 or more

services.title: Drop Yard
services.text: Ground to drop and swap trailers near the Houston Ship Channel container terminals.

services.title: Short-Term Parking
services.text: A spot for 24 hours, 48 hours, one week or two weeks, taken on the licensee application.
points: One week and two week terms

services.title: Month-to-Month and Long Term
services.text: Month-to-month spots at the monthly rate, with long term options available.

groups.title: Access and Security
groups.summary: Controlled access around the clock on a lighted, fenced yard that is managed on site.
groups.intro: The yard is fenced, lit and covered by security cameras, and every licensee enters on a code of their own. Access is controlled 24 hours a day, so a trailer can be dropped or pulled at any hour.

services.title: 24/7 Controlled Access
services.text: Access to the yard is controlled around the clock rather than limited to office hours.

services.title: Unique Coded Entry
services.text: Entry is on a unique code, so the yard knows who came through the gate.

services.title: Lighted, Fenced and On Camera
services.text: A secure location: the yard is lighted, fenced and watched by security cameras.

services.title: Site Management
services.text: The site is managed day to day. We focus on quality, not quantity.

promo.title: Spots by the day or by the month.
promo.text: The same spot, the same yard, whether the trailer sits overnight or stays on month to month.

about.title: A gated trailer yard near the terminals.
text: Secure Spots leases trailer parking and drop yard space on gated ground in La Porte, close to the Bayport and Barbours Cut container terminals. A spot is taken for 24 hours, a week, or month to month, one spot or thirty.

The yard is lighted, fenced and covered by security cameras, with controlled access around the clock and a unique entry code for every licensee. The site is managed rather than left to itself, and the standard the company sets for it is quality, not quantity.

facts.heading: Leasing a Spot
facts.text: Leasing starts with the licensee application, which asks for your name, company, start date, term and the number of spots you need, from one up to thirty-one or more.

facts.heading: Hazardous Materials
facts.text: The licensee application asks whether the load carries hazardous materials, and for the MSDS numbers that go with it.
